exposure: fetal growth restriction (FGR) diagnosed between 17 and 22 weeks and 6 days' gestation
outcome: small for gestational age (SGA) neonate at delivery
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent a routine fetal anatomy ultrasound between 17 and 22 weeks and 6 days' gestation at a community-based academic hospital
finding: Early onset FGR is associated with high rates of SGA at delivery, as well as several adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes, including hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, a greater composite neonatal morbidity, perinatal death, and medically indicated preterm delivery.
